semantic_reason: The PR fixes issue #1172: ABCSize counted each @impl module attribute inside quote blocks as +2, producing inflated complexity (e.g. 3.0 instead of ~0). The patch changes the existing traverse_abc clauses in lib/credo/check/refactor/abc_size.ex to ignore unquote calls and count module attribute calls as 1; the two triggering tests verify the corrected behaviour. This corrects an existing reported defect, not a feature.
delegation_note: Defect-semantics review remains agent-delegated; patch minimization was separately confirmed by the human dataset curator on 2026-09-12.
